description: This file contains implementation of the TType class and related classes/functions for handling shader data types, including type string representations, mangled names, size calculations, and type properties within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TType
classes.description: Represents shader data types with properties like basic type, size, qualifiers, array dimensions, and methods for size calculation, name mangling, and type properties.

classes.name: TPublicType
classes.description: Public interface for shader type specification, including initialization and array handling.

classes.name: TFieldListCollection
classes.description: Collection of shader fields, providing size, nesting, and type containment analysis.

methods.name: getBasicString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a basic shader type.

methods.name: TType::TType
methods.description: Constructors for TType, initializing various type properties.

methods.name: TType::canBeConstructed
methods.description: Checks if the type can be constructed.

methods.name: TType::getBuiltInTypeNameString
methods.description: Returns the built-in name string for matrix and vector types.

methods.name: TType::getDeepestStructNesting
methods.description: Returns the deepest nesting level of a struct type.

methods.name: TType::buildMangledName
methods.description: Generates a mangled name for the type, including array sizes and struct/interface info.

methods.name: TType::getObjectSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the type object, considering arrays.

methods.name: TType::getLocationCount
methods.description: Returns the number of locations occupied by the type.

methods.name: TType::sameNonArrayType
methods.description: Checks if another type has the same non-array properties.

methods.name: TType::isElementTypeOf
methods.description: Checks if the type is an element type of a given array type.

methods.name: TType::sizeUnsizedArrays
methods.description: Assigns sizes to unsized array dimensions.

methods.name: TType::sizeOutermostUnsizedArray
methods.description: Sets the size of the outermost unsized array dimension.

methods.name: TType::setBasicType
methods.description: Sets the basic type and invalidates the mangled name.

methods.name: TType::setPrimarySize
methods.description: Sets the primary size component.

methods.name: TType::setSecondarySize
methods.description: Sets the secondary size component.

methods.name: TType::makeArray
methods.description: Adds a new array dimension.

methods.name: TType::makeArrays
methods.description: Adds multiple array dimensions.

methods.name: TType::setArraySize
methods.description: Sets size for a specific array dimension.

methods.name: TType::toArrayElementType
methods.description: Converts the type to its array element type.

methods.name: TType::toArrayBaseType
methods.description: Converts the type to its base type, removing array dimensions.

methods.name: TType::setInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Associates an interface block with the type.

methods.name: TType::getMangledName
methods.description: Returns the cached or builds the mangled name of the type.

methods.name: TType::realize
methods.description: Ensures the mangled name is generated.

methods.name: TType::invalidateMangledName
methods.description: Invalidates the cached mangled name.

methods.name: TType::createSamplerSymbols
methods.description: Creates sampler variable symbols for the type.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::containsArrays
methods.description: Checks if any field contains arrays.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::containsMatrices
methods.description: Checks if any field contains matrices.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::containsType
methods.description: Checks if any field contains a specific basic type.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::containsSamplers
methods.description: Checks if any field contains sampler types.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::buildMangledFieldList
methods.description: Builds a mangled string representing the field list.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::calculateObjectSize
methods.description: Calculates total object size of the field list.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::objectSize
methods.description: Returns cached object size.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::getLocationCount
methods.description: Returns total location count for the field list.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::deepestNesting
methods.description: Returns the deepest nesting level among fields.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::mangledFieldList
methods.description: Returns cached mangled field list string.

methods.name: TFieldListCollection::calculateDeepestNesting
methods.description: Calculates maximum nesting depth among fields.

methods.name: TPublicType::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the public type with a non-array type specifier.

methods.name: TPublicType::initializeBasicType
methods.description: Initializes the public type with a basic type.

methods.name: TPublicType::isStructureContainingArrays
methods.description: Checks if the user-defined structure contains arrays.

methods.name: TPublicType::isStructureContainingType
methods.description: Checks if the user-defined structure contains a specific type.

methods.name: TPublicType::setArraySizes
methods.description: Sets array sizes for the type.

methods.name: TPublicType::isArray
methods.description: Checks if the type is an array.

methods.name: TPublicType::clearArrayness
methods.description: Clears array sizes.

methods.name: TPublicType::isAggregate
methods.description: Checks if the type is an aggregate (array, matrix, or vector).
